title: Quick Start
subtitle: Get up and running in minutes
description: Learn how to set up Qortex in your React application and start fetching data immediately.
content: Get up and running with Qortex in minutes with this quick start guide.

callouts.title: Prerequisites
callouts.content: Make sure you have React 18+ and Node.js 16+ installed.

code.code:
# npm
npm install @qortex/query @qortex/query-react

# yarn
yarn add @qortex/query @qortex/query-react

# pnpm
pnpm add @qortex/query @qortex/query-react
